content.value: We are going to do the same work with all tasks now - we need to set a high general standard - the closer tasks chrono should be prioritized
This task-only child mission freezes one effective logical document per active Task ID. It does not alter the older mixed Paper-and-Task wave.

498 open, 4 blocked, 1 in progress; 33 draft-only and 470 published. Campaign controls created after the freeze are excluded. Canonical CycleFleet inventory digest: 1086b9c91e0600a353f4e682884cbe59f4176b3677dcd43e6e7a35346cc32846.

excluded_inventory.reason: Campaign control Task created after the immutable 503-unit freeze.
Campaign control Paper; this wave is explicitly task-only.

scale_profile.inventory_evidence: bp doc query task --filter 'lifecycle_status in open,blocked,in_progress' --perspective raw --limit 1000 --count -o json => 503 unique bare logical IDs; canonical sorted inventory SHA-256 be04210274e20a2872b38b595faf3254b9b3a48bccf25b63817628d254c604e1; closure-first chronological ranking SHA-256 439a53e649286347274aa5371e88c81a92464913cd0964cb0989552a8ebb7863.

quality_rubric.evidence: A criterion counts as met only when met=true and non-empty reproducible evidence names a commit, command, test, artifact, or URL that proves the exact criterion.
quality_rubric.lifecycle_truth: Lifecycle, live claim, dependencies, criteria, code references, blocker state, and outcome agree; completion and evidence are never inferred or fabricated.
quality_rubric.preservation_and_idempotence: Repairs preserve authored intent and unrelated fields; repeated normalization produces no further mutation.
quality_rubric.queue_order: Executable tasks sort by effective unmet criteria ascending, then _createdAt ascending, then logical id; no skip is allowed without a named blocker, human gate, parked state, or foreign claim.
quality_rubric.reader_visibility: Studio, TUI, email/task projection, CLI/API, and Projects/board expose the same task truth wherever that surface applies.
quality_rubric.structure_and_ownership: Outcome is explicit; parentage or legitimate root status is intentional; project and phase labels exist; real work has one to three exact bounded acceptance criteria.

target_surfaces: Projects board and public reader where applicable
scale_profile.unit_definition: One effective logical Barkpark Task document whose lifecycle_status was open, blocked, or in_progress at the 2026-07-18 freeze; draft and published physical rows with the same bare logical id count as one unit.

content.value: Count a criterion as met only when met=true and evidence is non-empty.
Sort by effective unmet criteria ascending. Tasks without formal criteria receive distance 50.
Add 20 for blocked, human-gated, decision-gated, infra-gated, or PARKED work while preserving honest state.
Add 100 for foreign-held claims; never steal them.
Break ties by _createdAt ascending, then logical Task ID ascending.
Every skip requires a named blocker or foreign claim in the ledger.

A Task is acceptable only when its outcome is explicit; parentage or legitimate root status is intentional; project and phase labels exist; criteria are exact and bounded; met criteria carry reproducible evidence; lifecycle, claims, dependencies, criteria, and code references agree; and all applicable readers expose the same truth. Completion evidence is never inferred or fabricated.
Survey 60/60; Verify 30/30; Experiment 3/15 completed with 0 failures; Build 0/15 opening floor; Review 0/15. Only exact typed assignments count.

scale_contract.unit_definition: One effective logical Barkpark Task document whose lifecycle_status was open, blocked, or in_progress at the 2026-07-18 freeze; draft and published physical rows with the same bare logical id count as one unit.

content.value: Stop only after every frozen Task is shipped, truthfully stalled, or explicitly excluded; the selected format is sealed; all applicable readers pass; Review 15 is complete; and Task, Paper, git, and CycleFleet authority agree.
Dispatch exactly 60 typed epic-surveyor assignments in waves of three over immutable, non-overlapping snapshots.
Each result records checked Task IDs, exact sample size, findings, evidence, risks, and unvisited ranges.
Before Digest, reconcile all 503 units with zero duplicate ownership, zero unknown IDs, and zero unexplained gaps.

Canonical digest: paper://task-quality-survey-digest-verify-plan-2026-07-18 at revision f2edf5b4204e5678c08bc6f67811d58d. Recurring report-level signals concentrate on dependency truth, reader gaps, metadata/placement debt, preservation/security risk, human gates, evidence debt, and closure candidates. Counts are explicitly report-presence indicators, not invented per-Task totals.

Verify manifest SHA-256 7cd0358e70565c56c4d31d7a0180f1bca1e6462301eae076e4f0843d539fa8dd. All 30 closure-first chronological shards completed ranks 1–503 without overlap, gaps, invalid assignments, or failed results. Wave-10 evidence Paper task-quality-verify-wave-10-2026-07-18 is publicly readable; honest transport-window limits remain explicit. Verify is permanently complete for this immutable wave.

Round 1 completed all three exact typed baselines across 18 fixtures. Exact Task transport passed, but dossier semantics and cross-reader projection failed the hard gate: derived-state contradictions, identifier token loss, closure drift, an exact duplicate pair, done-with-unmet evidence, unstructured human/destructive gates, and public/email/Projects reader gaps remain. Evidence Paper task-quality-experiment-round-01-baseline-2026-07-18 is public at revision 5c9730a36c7ea5eec66340ad7bc60d83. Round 2 now builds three isolated runnable candidates with distinct /tmp roots and zero production mutation.

Task Quality Standard — closure-first chronological Wave 1

User wish — verbatim

THE TASK STANDARD
We are going to do the same work with all tasks now - we need to set a high general standard - the closer tasks chrono should be prioritized

Strategic direction

This task-only child mission freezes one effective logical document per active Task ID. It does not alter the older mixed Paper-and-Task wave.

Scale profile

LEGENDARY · 503 LOGICAL ACTIVE TASKS
498 open, 4 blocked, 1 in progress; 33 draft-only and 470 published. Campaign controls created after the freeze are excluded. Canonical CycleFleet inventory digest: 1086b9c91e0600a353f4e682884cbe59f4176b3677dcd43e6e7a35346cc32846.

Queue law

Unsupported block: ordered-list

General task standard

A Task is acceptable only when its outcome is explicit; parentage or legitimate root status is intentional; project and phase labels exist; criteria are exact and bounded; met criteria carry reproducible evidence; lifecycle, claims, dependencies, criteria, and code references agree; and all applicable readers expose the same truth. Completion evidence is never inferred or fabricated.

Agent fleet

EXPERIMENT ROUND 1 SEALED · ROUND 2 NEXT
Survey 60/60; Verify 30/30; Experiment 3/15 completed with 0 failures; Build 0/15 opening floor; Review 0/15. Only exact typed assignments count.

Canonical CycleFleet ledger

STRATEGIZE · 503 UNACCOUNTED BEFORE SURVEY
Legendary CycleFleet wave revision 8a4e9609-849c-4e34-92b2-36acd3abe03a; 503 inventoried; Experiment round 1 has three typed baseline assignments started; Build remains sealed off. Exact reconciliation false.

Stop condition

ZERO UNACCOUNTED · ZERO ACCEPTED FAILURES
Stop only after every frozen Task is shipped, truthfully stalled, or explicitly excluded; the selected format is sealed; all applicable readers pass; Review 15 is complete; and Task, Paper, git, and CycleFleet authority agree.
